title: 100/10 recommend communal watching experiences!!   #connorstorrie #sa...
transcript: Come with me to see connor story make his saturday night live debut. Not in person, but this is definitely the second best option. When I heard that wilco's, my favourite women's sports bar, was doing an SNL watch party, I knew I had to go. I watched the heated rivalry finale here and it was so much fun. The vibes were amazing, and once again, it did not disappoint. I could not get over this energy. The moment I learned that connor story was going to be hosting SNL, I knew I wanted to watch with luke, even though it was very late. I am so glad we went. And people were so good. Like, obviously we laughed and cheered, but then everyone was also just, like, listening and enjoying the show. Well, except for one part. Moments later, though, we were back in. Connor's monologue was so good and endearing, and i'm so happy that hillary knight and megan keller got to be there. I'm gonna be super honest with you. I'm not really a sketch comedy person, so I was sort of just, like, in it for connor, but I really thought he did such a good job. First off, he was in every single sketch that wasn't weekend update. And, like, I am biased, but to me, he was just the and out. He never broke. He was always in it. He played so well with every single cast member. And then obviously the big highlight, Of the night. I was so happy that hudson williams was there. They just seem to be so happy to be together, and we're having so much fun. And I really think hudson was, like, utilized perfectly in this, like, very silly little sketch. And I really think it only added to what connor was doing. And I love that they got to introduce the band together, which, side note, mumford was great. And we got hozier surprise, which the bar lost it, including myself. Now, the best sketch of the night by far was the stripper who's been in an accident sketch, which the internet quickly figured out was a sketch based on one of connor's own clown characters, which is just so incredibly cool. He was truly just born to do this. I'm so glad I got to be in a room full of enthusiastic people to watch this. I truly can't think of a better experience. Congrats, connor. We're so proud of you. Just like hudson.
